referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Process energy requirements were taken into account to convert the by-product thomas slag into a commercial fertiliser. Additionally, transports from the plant to the regional storehouse were supplemented. No data on process emissions were available. Infrastructure and land use were included by means of a proxy-module.
